title: Digital Transformation Handbook (DTH)
description: A WHO guidance publication on digitalising one area of a health system — an L1 publication whose body is a planning method rather than recommendations. It sits within the DIIG process and should use the DPI-H Reference Architecture (owner, 2026-10-01). Its domain sections map onto smart-kg L2 (DAK) classes: a DTH states for a health-system area what a DAK states for a guideline. Structure read from the three DTHs ingested in smart-base/library; a section is required only where all three have it. The Reference Architecture for DPI-H calls itself "A Digital Transformation Handbook for DPI-H" and is cited here as the architecture the others should reference.

sections.title: Position in the DIIG process and SMART Guidelines layers
sections.description: Which phase of the DIIG's "planning and implementing a digital health enterprise" process the handbook supports, and its alignment to the SMART Guidelines layers. The seven phases have ONE source, DIIG §1.1 Fig. 1.1.1 (owner, 2026-10-03, #1984: "use one DIIG seven phase figure as source"); a DTH cites that figure for them, and the copies the handbooks print (PHC Fig. 6, SC Fig 5, PC Fig. 4) are reproductions of it, not further sources. The primary health care DTH places itself in Phase 5, determining health content requirements; the Reference Architecture's Figure 1, which adapts the DIIG figure, places the supply chain and product catalogue handbooks in Phase 7, and the Reference Architecture itself across Phases 1-4. The reproductions and the SVG rendering (bean 70zt) are listed on smart-base/findings/dth-terms.md.
